title: Every module over a field is flat
statement: Let $k$ be a field and $M$ a $k$-module (a $k$-vector space). Then $M$ is a flat $k$-module [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]: $M$ has a basis, so it is free, and free modules are flat.
